issues: 主角卡是 #3a3a3a 平色块，只有 "PRO" 加两根灰条，读不出是什么卡
背景是平铺 G.bg 浅灰，卡只有一层泛灰投影，没有空间感
扫光是一条 0.32 的单层渐变带，扫过时卡面本身毫无反应，像贴了一张透明胶片
光带从卡外 1216px 开始走，inOut 匀速中段大多耗在卡外，真正扫过卡面只有约 4f，几乎看不清
changes: 卡改为深墨渐变会员卡（#2a2c35→#111216，28px 圆角，内发丝线 + 上沿内高光 + elevation 36 两层软阴影），内容是 Workspace 标识、Annual plan chip、PRO 大字、权益一句话和 $24/seat
背景改为暖灰纵向渐变 + 左上主光斑 + 轻暗角 + 静态颗粒，卡下加一块贴地接触影
高光带改成宽柔光（0.05–0.10）+ 窄亮芯（峰值 0.32）两层，screen 叠在深墨上；卡面 25° 细斜线暗纹常驻 0.03，只在光带经过处被同角度遮罩照到 0.16；卡上沿发丝线跟着光带同步亮起
光带中心改为从卡左外 300px 走到卡右外 300px，仍是 40–68f inOut cubic 只扫一次，扫过卡面约 10f；扫光层条件挂载，68f 后整层卸载
补 SHEEN_SWEEP_RETRY_DURATION = 140（40f 静止 + 28f 扫光 + 72f 真静止）
issuesEn: The hero card was a flat #3a3a3a block with "PRO" and two grey bars; there was no telling what kind of card it was
The background was a flat G.bg light grey and the card had one muddy shadow, with no sense of space
The sheen was a single 0.32 gradient band; the card surface did not respond as it passed, like a strip of clear film laid on top
The band started 1216px off the card, so most of the even-speed middle of the inOut ease ran off-card; it crossed the card for only about 4f and was barely readable
changesEn: The card is now a deep-ink membership card (#2a2c35→#111216, 28px radius, inner hairline, top inner highlight, two-layer elevation-36 shadow) carrying a Workspace mark, an Annual plan chip, the big PRO, a one-line benefit and $24/seat
Background is a warm-grey vertical gradient with a top-left key light, light vignette and static grain, plus a contact shadow under the card

The sheen is now two layers, a wide soft wash (0.05–0.10) and a narrow hot core (peak 0.32), screened over the ink; a 25° fine-line guilloche sits at 0.03 and is lit to 0.16 only where the band passes, through a mask at the same angle; the card's top hairline brightens in step with the band

The band centre now travels from 300px left of the card to 300px right of it, still one 40–68f inOut-cubic pass, crossing the card in about 10f; the sheen layers are conditionally mounted and unmounted after 68f
Added SHEEN_SWEEP_RETRY_DURATION = 140 (40f still, 28f sweep, 72f truly still)
